event.text: You can manage this at home for now: keep the area clean, avoid scratching, and your pharmacist can advise on over-the-counter options for itching. Poison ivy rash typically appears in the exposed areas and may seem to spread as skin reacts. If the rash becomes severe or widespread, involves the face or genitals, or you develop fever, pus, spreading redness with pain or warmth, contact a health care provider that day; if breathing or swallowing becomes difficult, call 911.
